stages.name: backend Agent
stages.native_turn: aborted by sustained host memory warning

observed: The frozen backend checker passed 2/2 against the interrupted Agent's source, covering the original test and HTTP import/filter/PATCH/export behavior. The Agent did not finish or hand off that turn. Its native history shows repeated self-managed server and scratch-test attempts before the resource guard stopped it; the untracked scratch test was archived in private evidence.

The broad UI stage changed 595 lines across app.js and style.css before timing out while inspecting its diff. Its first independent browser check failed at Save with a null-value page exception and no POST because the code queried nonexistent input IDs and registered competing submit handlers.

A narrow Save repair completed with a native compaction and added input IDs, but an unchanged independent browser retry still failed. It sent PATCH /api/entries/{new-id} and received 400 instead of sending POST. The source rejects empty IDs, then checks !idValue to select POST, making that branch unreachable. The page sent no subsequent POST.

Source inspection also found a multipart Import request against a raw-CSV API and unescaped row data in an innerHTML template. Those are unqualified or failing UI paths; no browser completion is claimed.

After the resource abort and after final browser testing, doctor reported healthy idle 65,536-context runtime, normal host pressure, connected browser/search, and unchanged 415435325-byte swap. One sustained host warning during the backend turn fails the resource gate even though it later settled.
